tools.title: Design stages
tools.desc: Dependency-based development model: what to draw, in what order.

tools.title: Glyph chart
tools.desc: Font tester: base letters × vowel marks and compound signs.

tools.title: Spacing workbench
tools.desc: Inspect and tune the spacing scheme against a font.

tools.title: Test generator
tools.desc: Real words and running text using only the graphemes a font has.

tools.title: Glyph name ↔ Unicode
tools.desc: Convert Sinhala clusters to LankaGlyphset names and back.

tools.title: spacing-map
tools.desc: Builds sinhala-spacing.yaml from the stages model and audits a font's sidebearings.

tools.title: composite-map
tools.desc: Builds the composite map and rebuilds atomic glyphs as composites in Glyphs sources.

tools.title: lankafea
tools.desc: Generates Sinhala/Tamil OpenType features from lanka-glyphsets; also a Glyphs 3 plugin.

tools.title: Glyphs filters
tools.desc: Generates Glyphs 3 sidebar filters from the models into filters/.

tools.title: Sinhala Glyph Builder
tools.desc: Visual picker to add Sinhala glyphs (draw, composite or features) and build the composite map into a font.
commands: # restart Glyphs, then Glyph ▸ Sinhala Glyph Builder

tools.title: Lanka Features
tools.desc: Runs the lankafea generator inside Glyphs: Sinhala/Tamil OpenType features gated on the glyphs in the font.
commands: # restart Glyphs, then Glyph ▸ Lanka Features

tools.title: Corpus build
tools.desc: Builds the test-generator data bundle from the raw UCSC corpora (not in the repo).
